release_notes:
Fix: Wise/Zelle reconcile crons can double-credit a duplicate invoice

The amount-only (no-reference) auto-match passes in wise_reconcile.php and
zelle_reconcile.php had no way to know a deposit had already been accounted
for when an admin manually approved a duplicate invoice by hand instead of
through the automated flow — nothing updates the cron's own idempotency
state (TransactionId / the IMAP claimed flag) in that case. The cron would
then "discover" the same still-unclaimed deposit again and auto-credit a
second, pending, same-amount invoice from the same customer.

Add a shared guard (gf_payment_user_recently_settled) that every guess-based
match (amount-only, or Zelle's memo-username match) now checks first: if the
same user already has another paid invoice on this payment method for the
same amount, within the same match window, leave the new invoice pending for
manual review instead of crediting it again. Explicit reference matches
(the deposit literally names the invoice) are untouched — that's independent
evidence, not a guess.
